item.title: Estovia and Karelan delegations resume ceasefire talks in Geneva
item.description: Estovia and Karelan delegations resume ceasefire talks in Geneva. Negotiators from both sides met for a second day at a hotel in Geneva. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

Strong earthquake shakes Tamarinda coast, buildings damaged
item.description: Strong earthquake shakes Tamarinda coast, buildings damaged. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said. Rescue teams were searching collapsed buildings in several coastal towns.

item.title: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff
item.description: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff. Opinion polls had shown the two candidates separated by only a few points.

item.title: Wildfires force thousands to flee southern Mirabel
item.description: Wildfires force thousands to flee southern Mirabel. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.

item.description: Former Carvonia minister goes on trial for corruption. Officials said more details were expected later today.
